lead: Enrique Iglesias is best known as a Spanish singer-songwriter, born on 8 May 1975 in Madrid.

He has 60 credited works on public record and has been recognised with Latin Grammy Award for Best Urban Fusion/Performance and Grammy Award for Best Latin Pop Album.

sections.heading: Enrique Iglesias — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Enrique Iglesias was born on 8 May 1975 in Madrid, and holds Spanish nationality. He was given the name Enrique Miguel Iglesias Preysler at birth and is publicly known as Enrique Iglesias.
Public records name his mother, Isabel Preysler. He is a sibling of Julio Iglesias Jr., Chabeli Iglesias, Tamara Falcó Preysler, Ana Boyer Preysler, Cristina Iglesias and Victoria Iglesias.
He received his education at University of Miami.
He is recorded as speaking Spanish and English.

sections.heading: Enrique Iglesias — Career and Professional Work

He performs on guitar, piano and electric guitar.
